title: "Song of Solomon"

# Song of Solomon

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Song of Solomon celebrates the beauty of covenant love and marital intimacy. The book teaches that faithful love reflects God's good design for relationships.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Song of Solomon 1:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth</div>

### Why This Verse

Opening declaration of love

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the love between the bride and bridegroom. The key verse highlights the attraction, admiration, and delight found in covenant love.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Song of Solomon 2:4</div>

<div class="identifier">His banner over me was love</div>

### Why This Verse

Most quoted verse in the book

### Chapter Insight

This chapter celebrates the beauty of love and the joy of being together. The key verse expresses security and belonging within a loving relationship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Song of Solomon 3:4</div>

<div class="identifier">I found him whom my soul loveth</div>

### Why This Verse

Beloved devotional passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the bride's search for her beloved and their union. The key verse emphasizes the value of committed love that perseveres through longing.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Song of Solomon 4:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou art altogether beautiful, my love</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous affirmation of beauty

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the bridegroom's praise of the bride. The key verse highlights the beauty, worth, and cherished nature of covenant love.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Song of Solomon 5:16</div>

<div class="identifier">He is altogether lovely</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted in Christian devotion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records separation and renewed pursuit. The key verse emphasizes appreciation and devotion even during relational difficulty.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Song of Solomon 6:3</div>

<div class="identifier">I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant love theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter celebrates reconciliation and enduring affection. The key verse expresses the mutual commitment and exclusivity of true love.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Song of Solomon 7:10</div>

<div class="identifier">I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me</div>

### Why This Verse

Mutual affection

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues the celebration of marital love and admiration. The key verse highlights delight in one another within the covenant relationship.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Song of Solomon 8:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Many waters cannot quench love</div>

### Why This Verse

Climactic statement on love

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes by emphasizing the strength and permanence of love. The key verse presents love as a powerful, enduring gift that cannot be purchased or extinguished.
:::
